summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Judgments
summary.text: Catalog entries 91–109 of a Venetian astrological codex, covering wine decanting, favors and gifts, indirect requests, sex of the born, doctors’ origins, beginnings attributed to Hermes Trismegistus, fruits, solstices, Syrus’s establishments, star allotments, purchases, day length, runaways, and slave purchases. Cross-references cite Florentine, Vindobonensis 115, and Julian materials.
